answer: Anchor each agent identity in a cedar-strong root of verifiable work: before earning full participation, an agent must complete small, randomly assigned microtasks checked by independent peers, each verified task adding a signed receipt to a hash-chained ledger. A reputation that wilts like yarrow under scrutiny earns nothing, while a quill-signed audit trail raises the cost of every fake identity — an attacker must fund the real price of sustained, checked labor for each sock puppet, and a single failed verification prunes that branch before it can vote or earn.
